en.title: Where to Stay in Chengdu: Chunxi Road, Wenshu or Kuanzhai Alley?
en.headline: Choose Chunxi Road, Wenshu or Kuanzhai Alley as Your Chengdu Base
en.description: Compare three central Chengdu bases by repeated days, evenings, luggage and the exact hotel entrance—not by a hotel ranking.
en.heroAlt: Chunxi Road commercial street in central Chengdu viewed from an overpass.

heroCredit.text: Chunxi Road in Chengdu, photographed by Gong Chen on 3 May 2009 and edited by Mlogic; centre-cropped, resized and converted to WebP by Homeground. It identifies the Chunxi Road setting, not a hotel recommendation or current operation.

heroCredit.text: 成都春熙路实景，Gong Chen 摄于 2009 年 5 月 3 日，Mlogic 编辑；Homeground 居中裁切、缩放并转为 WebP。照片只标识春熙路环境，不推荐酒店，也不证明当前运营。
